checks.name: Workspace opens without login, ignores obsolete sessions and makes no auth requests
Countries first; unrated collapsed; empty country shows evidence
Pin, checklist and escaped notes survive reload; unpin preserves progress
Country selection supports bulk research and completion without changing submission
Priority/order persistence, shortcuts, country search and invalid routes
Legacy import is explicit, idempotent and preserves original bytes
Calendar download has exact UTC deadline and four alarms per event
Eight tabs and country detail: desktop/mobile, both themes, no page overflow
Deletion dialog focuses Cancel; Escape preserves scholarship
Export and previewed JSON import restore progress in a clean browser without login
Malformed backup shows an inline error and preserves existing progress
Offline local writes and another tab preserve the same browser workspace
Local quota failure retains an exportable draft and Retry saves it
Corrupt browser state is exportable and cannot be silently overwritten
Blocked storage still opens an editable workspace with export and inline import recovery

scope: No-account device release; no real OAuth or live database needed.
